trigger: mark_endpoint_applied/mark_endpoint_confirmed fails (concurrent release or genuine store error) after a dispatch was already accepted or a status read already confirmed state|active
summary: No audit row was recorded when the durable stamp write failed after a real, agent-facing containment action already happened - the audit trail silently disagreed with reality on a security-control-adjacent path.
waiver_rationale: Fixed in commit 8e28fd80d via a shared audit_unstamped() helper wired into both the apply and confirm failure branches, outside the lock. Independently re-verified as fixed by cpp-safety during the Gate 3 pass (reviewed_at_sha 8e28fd80d) and covered by a new mutation-tested regression test (test_quarantine_containment_reconciler.cpp, wires a real AuditStore, asserts result="failure").

trigger: security-hardening.md and metrics.md described the agent-side mutation gate's 2-second-bounded status|busy behavior as already-shipped fact
summary: A detail belonging to open, unmerged PR #3429 was mis-transcribed into this PR's own shipped-behavior documentation as current fact.
waiver_rationale: Fixed in commit 8e28fd80d: replaced with an accurate description gated on #3429 landing, plus a new disclosed "Known limitation" paragraph for the K8/CDX-P1-01 TOCTOU.

trigger: DELETE /api/v1/quarantine/{agent_id} commits between redispatch_stored_containment's get_status read and its dispatch_fn call inside one reconcile_one invocation
summary: A device released at the exact moment the reconciler is mid-dispatch can end up re-firewalled just after release (over-containment, never under-containment) - already disclosed in the header ("KNOWN RESIDUAL RACE") and docs/user-manual/security-hardening.md's "Known limitation" paragraph, but has no GitHub issue number yet.
classification: truth, disclosed limitation, no tracking issue
waiver_rationale: Design tradeoff accepted at plan time (proper fix needs a claim/generation token on the active row, a real schema change of its own). Disclosed in-code and in-docs, not silent. Filing the tracking issue is queued for operator approval per this repo's no-unilateral-issue-filing convention.

summary: kQuarantineReapplyResults's doc comment claimed every result value has exactly one emit site; several (degraded, not_reached, reapplied, dispatch_error, busy) have multiple, all semantically identical. Independently found by architect and cpp-safety.

trigger: an authenticated operator posts a whitelist >512 chars or with unsafe characters via POST /api/v1/quarantine, which performs no length/charset validation
summary: A record written this way was already permanently undispatchable before #3425 (MCP's already_active path already rejected it); this PR makes the failure a standing, repeating per-tick/per-heartbeat validation_failed loop instead of a dormant one. The shared validator (quarantine_reapply.hpp) already exists, so the REST fix is one include away.
waiver_rationale: Not a regression this PR introduced (the record was already undispatchable pre-#3425); scoped out of this round per operator's authored-lines-only convention, queued as a fast-follow-up for approval.

trigger: the reconciler's tick thread wedges or dies (e.g. an undeadlined AgentRegistry::send_to Write on a black-holed direct-connect peer) while reapply work exists or later arrives
summary: No metric distinguishes a dead/wedged reconciler from an idle-and-healthy one - flat counters plus a zero gauge is the identical signature for both. Three sibling reapers in this repo (audit retention, rotation sweep, response reap) all carry a last-pass-timestamp gauge plus a NotRunning alert for exactly this reason.
waiver_rationale: Recommended: yuzu_server_quarantine_reconciler_last_tick_timestamp_seconds gauge + YuzuQuarantineReconcilerNotRunning alert, following the existing template. Queued as a follow-up for operator approval rather than expanding this PR's observability surface unilaterally.

trigger: a server restart drops all in-memory confirmed state; the first tick repopulates unconfirmed_cache_ fleet-wide and each such agent's next heartbeat drives a full reconcile_one inline, gated only by the per-agent 60s claim, not by kMaxDispatchesPerTick
summary: Post-restart reconnect burst is paced by the per-tick cap on the periodic path but not on the heartbeat fast path - increases heartbeat-processing load fleet-wide during a mass-reconnect window without corrupting state.
waiver_rationale: Bounded blast radius (individually rate-limited, idempotent); quarantine population characterized as manually-curated security events, not high-volume. Queued alongside the related performance finding on the gateway batch path.

trigger: a quarantine.status follow-up read reports inactive/partial/uncertain/degraded/unknown, or a timed-out apply's eventual re-dispatch once backoff elapses
summary: The 'not yet actually contained, keep retrying' branch - the mirror image of the one tested active-to-confirmed transition - has zero integration coverage; only the negative 'not yet eligible' half of the eventual-retry path is tested.
waiver_rationale: Bounded blast radius per governance rule (SHOULD, not floor). Queued as a test-coverage follow-up batch.

trigger: no test seeds >50 unconfirmed records to verify kMaxDispatchesPerTick's cap and its skip-does-not-consume-budget contract
summary: The fair-cap fix from the adversarial-review round (K11/CDX-P1-05, a previously-fixed starvation bug) has no regression test proving the fix, despite the class header naming the contract explicitly.
waiver_rationale: Bounded blast radius (delay, not permanent block, for agents beyond position 50). Queued as a test-coverage follow-up batch.

trigger: last_applied_at/last_confirmed_at are marked required in the MCP quarantine_device response schema but no test asserts their presence/correctness in either the REST list JSON or the MCP response payload
summary: MCP output schemas are advertised but not automatically enforced against actual responses (project precedent) - a dedicated test is the only guard against silent drift on a now-contractually-required field. Store-level round-trip is well tested; the two wire surfaces are not.
waiver_rationale: Queued as a test-coverage follow-up batch.

trigger: a CI-load scheduling gap >400ms between the backoff-doubling tick and the immediately-following heartbeat claim attempt in one regression test
summary: A generous (400ms) but still theoretically finite margin; recommend widening the override or asserting via the rate_limited counter instead of the dispatch-count/timing proxy.
waiver_rationale: Queued alongside the other test-coverage follow-ups.

summary: Two brand-new test files ship with no row; the existing test_quarantine_store.cpp row doesn't mention this PR's 5 new schema-v2 TEST_CASEs. Pre-existing sibling gap (two other quarantine test files were already undocumented) not originated by this PR, only added to.
waiver_rationale: No correctness risk. Queued alongside the other test-coverage follow-ups.

trigger: the conjunction of Postgres pool degradation and one or more quarantined-unconfirmed agents present in one gateway-routed BatchHeartbeat RPC, which loops sequentially and invokes the reconcile hook inline per entry with no per-entry latency isolation from the batch
summary: A slow-but-not-throwing pool acquire on one quarantined agent in a batch stalls the whole sequential loop, delaying the ACK for every other (potentially thousands of) agents riding the same batch. The one finding from this review worth prioritizing.
waiver_rationale: Non-blocking per derivation (MEDIUM, not HIGH/CRITICAL) but flagged as the highest-priority follow-up of this Gate 3 round. Suggested remediations: skip the hook on the gateway batch path (rely on tick()'s 20s backstop), give the reconcile attempt a fast non-blocking pool probe, or move the dispatch off the RPC handler thread. Re-scope against the Gate 3 fix round's HeartbeatIngestion locking change before filing.

trigger: a Heartbeat-RPC handler thread is inside quarantine_reconcile_fn_(...) (blocking Postgres + gRPC-dispatch I/O) when server.cpp's stop() sequence nulls the unsynchronized std::function and then .reset()s the QuarantineContainmentReconciler its closure captures, past only a bounded (not quiescence-guaranteeing) gRPC drain deadline
policy_floor: ownership/lifetime defect (cpp-safety blocking contract) - unsynchronized cross-thread callback reassignment racing operator(), plus a post-reset dangling capture
summary: quarantine_reconcile_fn_ was a bare std::function with no synchronization against concurrent teardown - a genuine cross-thread use-after-free window during a routine rolling restart against live heartbeat traffic, not merely theoretical.
waiver_rationale: Fixed by adding std::shared_mutex quarantine_reconcile_mu_: ingest() holds a shared_lock for the FULL duration of the callback (not just to copy it, which would not restore the drain-barrier property), set_quarantine_reconcile_fn takes a unique_lock, making set(nullptr) an actual drain barrier before .reset() runs. Verified via a deterministic latch-based regression test (test_heartbeat_ingestion.cpp), mutation-tested by temporarily removing the lock and confirming the test fails, then restoring. Scoped to quarantine_reconcile_fn_ only, per operator convention against sweeping fixes onto unauthored pre-existing sibling code (guardian_reconcile_fn_ has the same shape, recorded as a separate follow-up candidate in the resource ledger, not fixed here).

trigger: no governance.d/*.resource-ledger.md and no run ledger governance.d/*.jsonl existed for this change despite the diff introducing a new owning thread and two new callback-registration owners
policy_floor: Resource Ledger omission on a C++ diff
summary: Gate 1's Resource Ledger contract was not satisfied for this change's owning-boundary-introducing constructs.
waiver_rationale: Cured in this round: governance.d/3425-quarantine-reconnect.u21SjI.resource-ledger.md written (enumerating the new thread, the new shared_mutex, the 5 borrowed Deps pointers, the dispatch_fn/now_fn captures, the reused PG-lease pattern, and the test-only thread/latch usage), plus this run ledger backfilled with Gate 2 and Gate 3 findings.

trigger: mark_endpoint_applied fails with a non-"device is not quarantined" (generic store) error while agents_reached>0
summary: Unlike the symmetric confirm-failure branch, the apply-failure branch on a generic store error did not extend backoff, so a sustained QuarantineStore write outage re-dispatched a fresh quarantine-apply command every fixed ~60s instead of backing off exponentially like every other repeated-failure path.
waiver_rationale: Fixed by mirroring the confirm branch's next_backoff/next_eligible_at escalation on the generic-error path.
